batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b B Lee

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b WA Mota

batting.name: K Goel
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b MS Gony

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c Joginder Sharma b P Amarnath

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c Joginder Sharma b M Muralitharan

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c P Amarnath b Joginder Sharma

balls.text: on the pads, scooped away to backward square leg and Sreesanth pulls off a good save in the boundary, they get three and finish on 240. This just gets bigger and bigger. 25 off the last over. What a finish!
that's the neatest hit of the last two balls, Hussey waits for a full ball and smoothly blitzes it over long-on for a six, that's pure timing, what a clean hit
full and outside off, tries to swing but an inside edge goes towards mid-on
four more, full and on middle, Badri moves across and turns it cutely past short fine leg for another boundary
they've done it, the new highest total in the tournament, Badri just waits for the full one and powders it way over midwicket for a six, that a finish he's providing
slower one, but Badri detects that early, stands back, moves across and belts it way over square leg for a big six, he's showing his worth here
short of a length and Hussey can't get the timing right, he tries to swat it through midwicket but the leading edge balloons to third man, it finally falls in no-man's land as two fielders converge
that's blitzed over square leg for a magnificent six, scooped way over square leg for another six, this is turning into a carnage now, Hussey turning it on
punched to extra cover for a quick single, rotating the strike well Badri

and that's the hundred, the second in as many games, a hundred off 50 balls, McCullum's 100 was off 53 balls, this is quicker, he brings it up by tapping one to the off side, a big smile across his face and he can't hold his joy
tapped to the off side, slower one there
short and outside off, Badri thinks on his feet and ramps it past the keeper for four, fine glide there
slog sweeps it over midwicket for a four, he's doing this with ridiculous ease here, Kepler Wessles can't stop applauding, maybe he's saying, 'Why didn't I bat like this?"
low full toss, Hussey's eyes light up and he whacks it over long-on for a big one, he's smashing these as if he's popping peanuts
paddled away towards the leg side, poor fielding there and Irfan is fuming, that shouldn't have been a single, Sreesanth was too lax there
forced through the covers for a quick single, Yuvraj dives but they manage the run
cheeky, very cheeky, good length ball on off, paddled away mischievously through fine leg for four, sweetly done
full and outside off, punched to extra cover but no run, a dot ball is priceless here, Yuvraj goes for the direct hit but misses
full and straight, a bit of swing even now, Badri pushes towards midwicket and gets the single
low full toss on the pads, turned away behind square for a single
And again, crisp, clean, efficient hitting this, full and straight but Hussey uses his feet to swing over the bowler for a one-bounce four, this is a batsman in supreme control of his game

that's launched into the skies, good-length ball with some room outside off, Hussey swings in a controlled fashion and smotes that way over midwicket for six, huge blow, he knows exactly where to score them
short of a length ball, straight, tucked away towards backward square leg for a single, Hussey back on strike
good length ball outside off, powered down the ground for a single, long-off cleans up
full and straight again, Hussey can't get the room to free his arms, pushed towards mid-on for a single
good length on the off stump, Badrinath (or Badri, as he's fondly called) pushes to the off side and gets the single. That's his job here: give Mr Cricket the strike. Be Mrs Cricket (ouch)
good length ball on middle, tucked away to the leg side but they decide against the single

super yorker from Irfan, that takes out middle and leg stump, Oram looks to back away and tonk it over extra cover but his bat is still in the air as the stumps are rattled. Irfan is ecstatic, Preity does a jig in the stands, and the crowd goes ballistic. Welcome to Mohali
yorker length that time, dug out towards point
full and outside off, lifts it over long-off for a big one, Hopes comes around to try for the catch but that eludes his fingers and goes all the way
that's sailed into orbit, in the slot again and Hussey sets himself up for an almighty swish, way over long-on for a biggie, he's just smoked that one
low full toss from Mota and that's ripped straight down the ground like some tennis shot, pounded away through the long boundary for four, straight back behind the bowler
punched to the off side

full and outside off, lofted towards long-off but no real timing there, straight to Sreesanth but he makes a mighty mess of it, he's wearing shades and doesn't judge it, it strikes his palm and drops in front
short of a length and wide, Hussey throws his bat but can only find deep point
Full and on the pads, scooped over midwicket for four, Hussey showing his class here (and to think nobody wanted him in the first round of auctions!)
tries to turn it to the leg side, leading edge pops towards point
biffed savagely over long-off for a six, full and in the slot, Hussey tees off without a trace of inhibition, now is the time to go
good-length ball that comes in a shade, pushed tentatively towards the on side, something in it for the bowlers still (just don't be a spinner)
short and outside off, cut away fiercely for a single, run-rate is gradually coming down
short of a length, Hussey charges down the track but spanks it straight to Yuvraj at cover, well fielded, Punjab slyly coming back into the game here, good few balls for them
114.9kph, cuts down on his pace, glided away to third man for a single
125.3kph, full and outside off, Oram is hurried onto his shot, inside edge trickles towards the leg side, good over from Mota. Two wides but some useful deliveries. A wicket too
good ball that time, change of pace and slightly wide of off, tapped to cover for a single
similar ball, pushed down the ground for a single, little consolidation period here but you never know when either will go for broke
full and outside off, Oram punches it to the cover, gentle sneeze to start with but this man can roar
short of a length, too wide, Mota has a plan but is making a mess of it occassionally, Sangakkara is standing up
full and outside off, that seems to be Mota's plan, Hussey shovels it through mid-off for a single

Mota breaks through, good length ball and slightly wide again, Raina hammers it towards long-on but can't get the timing, straight down Irfan Pathan's throat, he gurgles that one without any problems. Mota plays for Mumbai in the Ranji Trophy but is starring for Punjab here.
full and too wide, no need to touch that one
down the ground this time, these two have hit to all corners, that wasn't hit as powerfully and they pick up a couple
swept away towards short fine leg
what a shot that was! dances down the track and larrups it over extra cover for a six, this boy can bat, ripping them with ease now
dabbed towards short fine leg and takes off for a single, that would have been close but Sangakkara has made a mess of the take, Raina gets home
fuller and straighter, Hussey skips down the track and hammers it over the bowlers head for four, he wasn't to the pitch of the ball but went for the shot anyway
lollypop of a full-toss and that's gone, way over midwicket for a six, fifty partnership comes up and this is getting even better for Chennai

full one this time and that's a straight-drive with class written all over it, full face of the bat and past the bowler for a meaty four, super shot that, classical shots merging with the slogs, what an over
huge! short and drifting on the pads, Raina rocks back and wallops that way over square leg for a big six, that sails into the crowds, what a blitzer, Chawla looks a bit lost here.
better ball that, straight and on middle, tucked away to the leg side
quicker again, outside off, Raina goes for the slog sweep but can manage only elevation and no distance, drops in the outfield like a golf shot
quicker one this time, slightly short too, pulled away for a single

over the wicket and tossed up, Hussey bull-dozes his way down the ground and pulverises that way over midwicket for a big one. Welcome aboard Piyush. Hussy launched himself into that one, almost as if it was pre-meditated.
reverse-paddles a full one towards short third man for a single
quick one outside off, Hussey comes down the track but can only manage an inside edge onto the pads that nearly trickles back onto the stumps, good reactions from Hussey to stop it from doing that
turned away towards the leg side but they can't get a single
full and quick again, Raina pushes towards mid-off and gets an easy single
similar ball, Hussey tries to turn it and get two more, but they decide against it
full and quick, Hussey pushes it towards midwicket and hurries through, Raina is quick and they get a couple
short this time, angled away towards third man for a single
that's disappeared over midwicket for six, full and on off, Hussey just wind-mills that over the in-field for six, too predictable from Irfan, more venom
135.1kph, yorker length this time, well done, Hussey can only dig it out, back down the ground
slight change of pace again, Raina pushes in the air but he was a bit too early on that, falls in the gap and they pick up a single
down the leg side and that's bread and butter for Raina, tucked away neatly down to fine leg for four, Pathan lets out some venom
slower one this time, straight too, Hussey just turns it away towards midwicket, easy single
full and outside off, a bit of movement away from the bat, beats the outside edge
short ball but Raina is ready, on the back foot and clobbers it over square leg for six, that's an impressive shot from Raina, gets the Chennai camp all geed up
down the track and tries to swat it over mid-on, can't get the timing right, straight to the fielder
132.5kph, full and outside off, Hussey punches it to the off side carefully,
short of a length, tapped to the off side for a quick single, direct hit but Raina is quick, he's in

Hopes strikes! full and outside off, jagging back in, Dhoni trapped on the back foot and tries to tap it to the off side, huge appeal straight away and Mark Benson gives that one, looked as if there could have been an inside edge there, but Dhoni walks back quickly
a little hop down the track, tries to flick towards leg but pads it away to cover, another quick run
full and outside off, thickish edge towards point, another quick single, not a bad over from Irfan this
short and pulled away towards midwicket, that's racing away towards the ropes but Piyush Chawla puts in a good dive, they scamper three but a good save
short of a length, Dhoni drives to cover and takes off for a quick single

bowled 'em! good length ball outside off, Hayden tries to pummel it through the leg side but can only get an inside edge onto the stumps, crack goes the timber and Punjab have struck. Hayden goes after a sweet cameo. 

Now I wonder if Sangakkara said anything in Hayden's ear. I can keep wondering.
full ball, Hayden backs away and Pathan follows him, Hayden tries to smash it over midwicket but an inside edge runs away to fine leg for four, that's one way you can be good at placement
a good end to the over after all, good length and outside off, drives and misses, through to the keeper
pushed to the off side, better length this time, not giving Hayden the room to free his arms
another swish, this is like a windmill now, leading edge sails high and between the mid-off and cover fielders. Just realised Hopes is Queensland too. This is an inter-state rivalry now.
gives himself room and tries to smash it over midwicket but that was a slower ball and he couldn't make contact, wild hoick that
and he makes 'em pay, down the track and smoked away way, way over long-off for six, that's a biggie, teeing off with remarkable ease. What was that about rubbing salt into wounds?

dropped, Hayden walking down the track and tries to smash him over mid-on straight away, but that's not that well timed, it ballons up towards Wilkin Mota at mid-on but he mis-times his jump and fluffs the chance, that runs away, it could be a costly miss
tapped to the off side but Goel is there, diving and stopping the single, he's already making an impression. Good comeback from Lee after a minor hammering.
changes his length, slightly shorter, tucked away to the leg side

and again, this time it's on the pads and whipped away effortlessly through midwicket, the fielder gives it a chase but can't get there, this is a quick outfield and they've also brought the ropes in, so it makes it easier for the batsmen
super shot, full and on off, spanked away through the covers for four, good placement between mid-off and cover, crackles away to the fence
Fine slow ball, that was delivered at 112kph, swinging towards the pads too, that foxed Hayden, he dabs it to the off side and gets a quick one
full and straight, Lee is doing it well here, driven back down the ground, why does the camera keep on showing Fleming? Ok, ok. Enough

full again, Hussey charges down the track as if there's no tomorrow and lofts over extra cover for four, it's sliced away and makes its way in the gap, now that's the sort of shot that makes you say 'It doesn't matter how they come ..." .. Actually an effective one that
driven sweetly to covers but fine fielding by Goel in the covers, that was racing away for four but the local lad pulls off a stop
full and outside off, Hayden backs away and looks to tee off, can't time it properly, though, and the bottom edge trickles to the on side, Sreesanth to Hayden and no verbals yet! This is just not IPL
short of a length, glided away to third man, Irfan Pathan is cleaning up at third man, surprising he's not opening the bowling
good length again, moving away outside off, left alone, this looks like what experts call a 'sporting wicket'. Something in it for everyone. The crowds slowly filling up.
140.4kph, that was a good length ball outside off, Hussey drives but can't make contact, Sangakkara is applauding Sreesanth feverishly, fine ball
short of a length, defended off the back foot, fine over from Lee
Straight and on the body, defended cautiously. This is Pura Cup action in Mohali. NSW v Queensland and WA

what a corker! short of a length, rising, speedy and outside off, takes off after pitching and snicks the outside edge of Parthiv's bat, through to the keeper and the umpire nods his head. Parthiv had no idea about that one. That was a Lee special.
short ball, Hayden tries to swat it away but can't get the timing, falls just short of the short fine leg, they scamper a single
Hayden makes room and tries to smash that towards Delhi, inside edge rattles the stumps but it doesn't matter, rarely has such a rattling of timber prompted such muted reactions
full and towards the leg side, Hayden makes room and swats it straight past mid-on for four, that's a no-ball and it's the tournament's first free-hit
Now that's a ball that you would see on the first day at the Gabba. Short of a length, rising outside off, Hayden pokes, beaten by the bounce, through to the keeper, glorious cricket
good finish to the over, full and straight, driven back to the bowler
full and outside off, driven but can't get the timing, Sreesanth has bowled a dot ball, now that's a big moment
round the wicket this time, wide of the stumps, too wide in fact, Parthiv lets it go and that's called wide
that was nearly one more, neatly clattered past point but the point fielder (Hopes) got his hands to it, so that's only two, this is sloppy stuff from Sreesanth.
three in a row, what a ripper, full and outside off and Sreesanth is clobbered through cover again, the fielder dives but was never going to get there, Parthiv on a roll here
edged and through where second slip would have been, might not have carried but that is four more, Parthiv is going after Sreesanth in style
And how he wishes he hadn't, full and outside off, Parthiv rattles it crisply past cover for four, boom that went, Sreesanth must have read too much into this 'Spirit of cricket' pledge
short of a length, Hayden tries to swing towards the on side and misses
Now that's Hayden for you, walking down the track and swatting Lee to midwicket for four, speedy outfield and that races away, this is the Aussie rivalry we've been waiting for
full and driven towards cover, straight to the fielder
fuller and slightly outside off, driven tentatively to mid-off and takes off for a quick single, Yuvraj has a chance to get a direct hit, but he misfields
straighter this time, 137.6kph, short of a length, tapped away back to the bowler, Parthiv on his toes for this one
Full and outside off, left alone by Parthiv. Now that's what I call a solid start
slower one to finish, Irfan can't make contact and it dribbles through to the keeper
dug out towards the off side for a single, good yorker
in the slot and that's smouldered over midwicket for a big six, Katich plonks his foot forward and swings hard, fine shot but a case of too little, too late
full and straight, Joginder ending it well here, no contact with bat on ball
another full one, no elevation, pushed to long-off
full and outside off, carved away towards deep point for a single
slower one, Katich down the ground but he can't get the timing, balloons up towards short midwicket
yorker length again, swatted towards fine leg but there's a fielder there mopping up
dropped, tough chance but Oram could have held on to it, driven powerfully back to the bowler, that was a tough one
full again, down the track but it's tough to get any elevation, driven to short midwicket
full and straight, swished towards long-on but only a single
pushed to mid-on for a single, that's a good way to go about it
pushed back to the bowler, fine over at this point, Murali is quite a champion
that's a mis-stumping from Dhoni, down the ground and beaten in the flight, that should have been a regulation stumping, but Dhoni misses that, he won't mind it too much given the match situation

he's holed out, desperate times look for desperate measures, Sangakkara down the ground and tries to loft him over long-on but can only find the fielder, Murali gets Sanga (now that's a rare entry in the scorebook). This match is headed in only one direction. Down south towards the Bay of Bengal.
another one in the yorker, sweeps but that is all along the ground to the fielder
quick and straight, driven down the ground
full and on off, Sangakkara can't get the elevation, only one to midwicket
fine finish, full on middle stump, Katich whips it away but can't find the boundary
good ball again, full and outside off, quick too, Sangakkara tries to stand and deliver but can only get an inside edge to the leg side
Finall Sangakkara gets the shot he's been looking for, walks across the stumps and shovels it over fine leg for a four, he's been looking for that shot for a while now.
low full toss, this is fine bowling, scooped away to square leg for a single
yorker length and straight, driven down the ground to long-on, the game's slipping away now, fireworks needed and now
too far down leg side, Katich moves across and tries to get the area over fine leg, struck on the pads
Another crazy-looking shot from Sangakkara, he's targetting the area behind fine leg but hasn't managed to get even one there, flays wildly and gets it in the air towards square
low full toss but Katich hammers it down to long-off and settles for a single
tries to paddle it but can only manage a hoick to square leg, the fielder comes around quickly
another poor piece of fielding at short midwicket, that was mis-timed but Hayden makes a mess of that and lets through a four, the pressure is on now
slower one this time, tries to swat it through the on side but that beats the bat
short of a length and straight, smattered towards point

he simply smoked it! short of a length and Sangakkara stands back and pulls with immense power, manages both elevation and distance as the ball soars over the midwicket fence. It's not over yet, it seems
short and wide, takes the pace off again, slapped away through point for a single
attempts a paddle to beat short fine leg but can't get the timing
waist-high full toss is savaged brutally through square leg, the fielder had no chance there

huge wicket that silences the crowd! Joginder takes off the pace and deceives Yuvraj, big hit goes wrong, not much timing and Amarnath comes around towards deep extra cover to take a sharp catch under pressure. Yuvraj needs to go and Punjab's hopes are slowly going up in smoke.

that is close! batsman makes room and gets one to midwicket, they think of a single but Sangakkara needs to go back, he slips but makes a valiant attempt, no direct hit but Dhoni grabs the ball and dislodges the bails, the third umpire is called up and this is really close. Waiting, waiting .... and he's safe. It was a line call but the benefit had to go to the batsman.
good finish, two dots in a row, quicker one that is pushed back to the bowler
beaten outside off, Dhoni goes for the stumping but Yuvraj is back in time
what a corker! one step forward, sets up for the slog sweep and pounds it way over square leg for six, that's a scorcher
too far down the leg side, surely a wide and a bye too
thinks of dancing down the track but stops in the last moment, flicked away to fine leg
on the back foot, tries to heave it over midwicket but can only manage a leading edge to long-off, single only
down the track and pushed to the cover region for a single
short of a length, glided away to third man for a single
gives himself room, the bowler follows him but that's swatted through midwicket for a four, fine placement despite the bowler following him, Yuvraj motoring along here
another shuffle but can't make contact, he's trying to target the area behind short fine leg but the slower one does him in
sliced towards cover, can't get the timing there but they poach a single
There is goes, Yuvraj tees off as only he can, smooth swing of the bat and rips that way over long-off for a six, 91 metres that one, what a monster. The king is here, long live the king
tries to shuffle across and heave it over the leg side but can't make contact, has to be happy with a single
full and straight, Sangakkara looks to paddle it towards fine leg but can't get the room, settles for a single
short of a length, Sangakkara tries to pull but can only slap it to cover, they don't take a single, this is a good comeback from Joginder
full and driven back to the bowler, Joginder vents his frustration with a direct-hit attempt at the stumps, Dhoni urges him to cool off
full toss that's slapped away to extra cover, sloppy effort from Gony in the deep and he's let that through for four, through his legs, Joginder is fuming, that was crucial
shot and that's a big one, walks down the track but manages the pull anyway, powerful shot that sails over the fence for maximum. Now then ...
pushed towards mid-off for a quick single, a game of cat-and-mouse here, someone needs to go for broke ... and now
patted away carefully through cover for a quick single
driven powerfully down to long-off for a single
129.5kph, outside off, steered to third man for a single, Yuvraj is away
Glided through third man for a single. The crowds going hoarse here

holes out this time, slower one and Hopes can't get the timing and lofts it straight to Joginder at long-off, too easy for him and Amarnath is overjoyed, Chennai break through, Brett Lee sighs in the dug-out
driven through covers and Hayden does well to keep them down to a single
down the track and carved through the in-field for a single
short that time and Sangakkara nearly decapitated Murali with a swat back down the ground, it raced past Murali like a bazooka bullet
controlled sweep behind square for a single, Murali doing it well here
turn there for Murali, strikes him on the pads but no run, an appeal goes up but that was going down leg
slog sweep of the highest class from Hopes, it's full and he's scorched that over long-on for a biggie
down the ground and chipped towards square leg for a single
slower one that stops on the batsman, Sangakkara chips it square for a single
down the leg side, Sangakkara can't get his bat onto that one, wide called
low full toss again, wide of the stumps, tapped away effortlessly through point for a single
slightly short and swivelled away over square leg for a single, gives Hopes the strike
full toss and he's lucky to get away this time, tapped down the ground for a single
that's clobbered over midwicket for another four, Hopes on fire here, unstoppable now, Joginder doesn't know where to look
low full toss and that's juddered away over extra cover for a four, fine attempt in the boundary from Parthiv but he can't reach that one
dropped, that was crunched straight back at the bowler, he stretched his right hand out but saw the ball popping out, tough chance but one nevertheless
that's his fifty and he brings it up in style, cracked through midwicket for a blistering four, 24-ball half-century from Hopes, what a cracker
too wide from Amarnath, slapped through point for a single, that could have been a wide if he had let it go
full and on off, struck through long-off for a single
yorker this time but that's raced away too, flicked away towards fine leg and the outfield does the rest
ripped over long-on for a one-bounce four, he takes on the tyro straight away,
fine over that, driven to long-off for a single, just six off Murali's first over
down the leg side, swept but the ball catches the pad and goes towards the slips, a mis-field allows for a single
full toss but Hopes can't get the timing, worked away to fine leg
down the track and crisply driven to long-off for a single, Sangakkara must be feeling a bit odd facing Murali instead of keeping to him
full and swept away powerfully to square leg for a single
full and on middle, tucked away to the leg side for a single
and the extra ball soars over fine leg for six, short and that seemed like a top edge that carried all the way, Gony pays the price for the wide, Punjab not giving in without a fight here
too short and too far down leg side, the umpires can't condone those

that's over, short and outside off, Goel goes for the pull but can't get on top of it, top edge balloons high and Parthiv Patel gets under it to hang on, Chennai get their first breakthrough. Gony is rewarded for some disciplined bowling.
slower one this time, gets the line wrong, down the leg side, clips the pad on the way to the keeper
too wide that one, Goel flays but he gets an extra ball after missing it

a really tough chance but Murali puts it down, Hopes pulls it savagely but Murali, at mid-on, takes off and almost pulls off the catch of the tournament. It doesn't stick to his outstretched right hand but saved a certain boundary.
backs away and slaps an imperious one over cover for six, that was as clean as a whistle and brings up the fifty partnership, Punjab have Hopes now
glided away to third man for a single, Goel giving the strike to his international partner
it's short this time and he pulls it away majestically for another four, through midwicket and into the fence, the decibel levels are soaring now
smoked over mid-off for a one-bounce four, that was outide off and he used the horizontal bat to great effect
slower one this time, 118kph, pushed to the off side for a single
slightly short and spanked away off the back foot, Joginder is patrolling the fence at square leg, though, only a single
slower ball, cut away straight to point, "wait" is the call
tries to power it past Oram but well fielded by the big man, every dot ball is priceless here

that's ripped with immense power, Goel sees that in the slot and launches Gony way over midwicket for six, that brings Preity Zinta to her feet, the rest are dancing in the stands here, that was a ripper
on middle and leg, turned away towards square for a couple
cramps him for room, this is fine bowling from Gony, driven towards long-on for a single
sliced away to third man, well fielded there and keeps them to a single
tapped to point and think of a single but "no" is the loud call
full and wide, driven towards point but well fielded there, the lights are casting a fluorescent yellow cloud over the ground
straight one this time, no room to free his arms, tip and run towards cover, 11 off the over, they needed 12 at the start of the innings.
full and outside off, tries to loft over extra cover but a thickish edge flies to third man,only a single
short one this time, Hopes goes for the swivel pull and, though he doesn't get the timing, manages to get the boundary, he almost turned around 180 degrees after that shot
130.9kph, short of a length and keeps the batsman quiet, tapped to the point fielder
full and wide, ripped through the cover region with a horizontal bat, through the gap and that's headed straight to the fence, they need many more of these
short of a length, tapped away to third man for a single
good length ball, angled away to third man for a single, fine over from Gony, should have had a wicket

dropped, short of a length, Goel goes for the pull but can only get a leading edge that sails high behind the bowler, Murali comes down but can't grasp his hands around it, trickles past the ropes for four, that should have been taken
87mph, good pace there, full and straight, driven crisply but straight back to the bowler
thick outside edge, fine length again, only one slip in place and that races past him, Oram makes a fine save at third man and keeps them down to a single
133.1kph, hits the deck and cramps Hopes for room, goes for the pull but lack of bounce does him in
short and cramps Goel for room, tapped to the on side for a quick single
width offered and Hopes clatters it through point for a four, that was crisply struck and races away
full and outside off, driven to long-off and straight to the fielder
on the pads and turned away for a single
drives but can't make contact
left alone outside off
Start as you go, smashed through the leg side for a boundary
